description: This file defines the Message class used in Google Test framework for streaming and formatting test messages, including operator overloads and internal utilities.

classes.name: testing::Message
classes.description: A class that facilitates streaming of various data types into a string, used for test message formatting.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloaded operators for streaming data into Message objects, including handling of pointers, booleans, wide strings, and manipulators.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Returns the accumulated message as a string, with null characters replaced by '\0'.
